title: checklist: re-point the Studio clauses the 2026-11-03 run measured as stale
body:
epic:#28130#1 · hotlong · session_040dfd80c4c9411b895c698e785a6848

Filing gate: ④ the run's stale-spec and assertion dispositions, one collecting card. Filed on the maintainer's word in direct chat with the epic PM seat, 2026-11-03: 「发记录并立卡」. ⛔ Not a claim.
QA-source: #29672 · studio-authoring.record-page-roundtrip · acceptance[0]
QA-source: #29672 · studio-authoring.api-written-keys-survive-studio-save · acceptance[2]
QA-source: #29672 · i18n.studio-follows-app-locale · acceptance[3]
Reader: `domain:devx` (`docs/qa/platform-checklist/**`).
type: checklist revision, no product change.

Each item gets a revision and a `history` row; `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs` stays green. Runner readings on `main` at `3482f3d8d2`.

| item | what is stale | re-point to |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `studio-authoring.record-page-roundtrip` [0] | #28907 draws `record:highlights` only for declared `highlightFields`, and `showcase_contact` declares none | `showcase_account`, which seeds it |
| `studio-authoring.api-written-keys-survive-studio-save` [2] | `titleFormat` is retired (3557366c02); publish refuses it | a live key |
| `i18n.studio-follows-app-locale` [3] | the #25884 ruling paints absolute dates in a grid, relative only as the tooltip | the tooltip |
| `studio-authoring.org-scope-flows` fixtures.requires[1], steps[1] | the clone door now lands in `.custom` (#28149), so it makes no package-less flow | a fixture that still reaches one |
| `studio-authoring.no-entry-property-matrix` | `drawerSide` and `drawerWidth` answer 422 now; the inspector now offers Layout, Columns, Default Tab and Tab Position | drop the rows, per step 4 |
| `studio-authoring.first-run-loop` | names no locale, and only zh-CN fails | a named zh-CN leg |

Fixture gaps found, same card: a launch entry with `OS_AUTOMATION_SCHEDULED_WORK_ENABLED=1` (`flow-status-matches-runtime`) and with `OS_PAGE_REACT_ENABLED=false` (`custom-page-source-tiers`); `picklist-bound-select`'s fixture needs a source edit.

Links back: #29672.
